userProvides.approvedVideo: A local MP4, MOV, or WebM with approved=true and a non-empty approvalNote
userProvides.brandWebsite: The official brand website used by the agent to source the visual ingredients

agentSources.brand.name: The brand name verified from the official website
agentSources.brand.logo: A local official JPG, PNG, WebP, or SVG logo with its exact source URL
agentSources.ingredientTwo: The featured product shown in the video, or the business hero product/primary offering when no product appears, with its exact source URL

ingredientPriority: featuredProduct when the finished video features a product
heroProduct when no product appears in the finished video
standaloneRule: The agent must be able to source the logo and ingredient two from the website without any parent Format or handoff.

defaults.layout: brand logo + product or offering + Wiggly -> approved output
